lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular spots arranged in vertical columns posterior to the gill slits; columns are approximately equidistant with spot density higher in the mid-lateral zone than the ventral margin.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of spots to form a faint rectilinear grid across the mid-flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple horizontal ridges extending from the posterior gill region across the flank, defined by a sharp vertical gradient with luminance maxima on the dorsal-facing edge and shadows on the ventral-facing edge.
